changes_made.explanation: Added 'Text-to-Vector Generation' as a dual task studied in the paper. Normalized model names and task descriptions. The paper studies both Vec2Text (summarization) and Text2Vec (generation) tasks.
Added missing metrics METEOR and NIST from Supplementary Table S3. Normalized all metric variants to base forms (e.g., BLEU-1, ROUGE-1, ROUGE-L → BLEU, ROUGE).
Removed placeholder 'None' values. The paper does not use LLMs as judges/evaluators of generated outputs.
Removed placeholder 'None' values. The paper does not mention any human evaluations of generated outputs.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on automatic evaluation of NLG tasks (Vec2Text summarization and Text2Vec generation) using the Textomics dataset. All evaluations are conducted using automatic metrics without human or LLM-based assessment. The extraction was generally accurate but missed some metrics mentioned in supplementary tables.
